name: Argent Guard Thaelrid
summary: Wounded near the Pool of Ask'ar, Argent Guard Thaelrid is cut off in Blackfathom Deeps. The night elf scout entered the submerged ruins for the Argent Dawn, and now he has seen what gathers below.

sections.title: Eyes of the Argent Dawn
sections.body: Reports of foul rites beneath the sea reached the Argent Dawn from the Zoram Strand. The order watches for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, so it sent Scout Thaelrid into Blackfathom Deeps. He was to judge the threat, watch the flooded temple, and report back. Then the Dawn could decide where aid was most needed.

sections.title: A Grasping Darkness
sections.body: Thaelrid found a threat far worse than the rumors suggested. Savage naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult have made an unholy pact in the submerged ruins. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, cultists offer blood sacrifices to feed the hydra Aku'mai and bargain with ancient terrors for dark power. Before Thaelrid could carry the warning to the surface, Blackfathom Deeps' denizens grievously wounded him. Cut off near the Pool of Ask'ar, he remains trapped.

faq.answer: Argent Guard Thaelrid is a night elf operative of the Argent Dawn. He entered Blackfathom Deeps along Ashenvale's coast to gather intelligence on the forces below.

faq.q: Why is Thaelrid trapped inside Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps' denizens discovered and grievously wounded Thaelrid as he reconnoitered the temple. Unable to fight back to the surface alone, he took shelter near the Pool of Ask'ar.

faq.q: What did Thaelrid discover in the depths?
faq.answer: Thaelrid found an unholy pact between the naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult in Blackfathom Deeps. The cultists sacrifice blood to feed Aku'mai and bargain with ancient terrors for dark power.
Thaelrid serves the Argent Dawn, a neutral order that fights corruption, evil, and apocalyptic threats across Azeroth, whatever the faction lines.

faq.q: What does Thaelrid ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Unable to leave his refuge, Thaelrid asks for Twilight Lord Kelris to be slain and the cult leader's head brought back as proof the threat is broken.
Thaelrid lies injured in a secluded alcove near the Pool of Ask'ar, just beyond Blackfathom Deeps' flooded preliminary caverns.

angles.text: For night elves, naga and doomsday cults defiling ancient temple grounds like Blackfathom is a bitter outrage. Thaelrid represents their people's vigil over Kalimdor's deepest wounds.
Alliance scouts follow up on Thaelrid's disappearance in Ashenvale, seeking to keep the Zoram Strand safe and support the Argent Dawn's neutral work.
Thaelrid is a night elf, but he serves the Argent Dawn. Any adventurer willing to strike at the Twilight's Hammer and cleanse the cavern can aid him.
